basic_details.job_title: INMS Research Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Institute of Nano Medical Sciences (INMS), Faculty of Medical Sciences, University of Delhi has invited applications for 01 Research Associate - I on a consolidated pay of INR 60,000/- per month. The post needs a Ph.D. in Chemistry, Nanomedical Sciences or Life Sciences plus a Master's degree. Applicants must email a CV with the relevant documents to [email protected] and [email protected]. The last date for receipt of application is 9 November 2026.

age_limit.details: The maximum age is 35 years. The notice gives no minimum age and prints no date for counting age. | Category Relaxation SC, ST, Physically Handicapped and Women applicants Up to 5 years OBC applicants 3 years

qualification.details: A Ph.D. degree in Chemistry/ Nanomedical Sciences/ Life Sciences, with a Master's degree (M.S./ M.Sc./ M.Pharm or equivalent) in a relevant subject with at least 1st Division or 55% marks (or equivalent OGPA).

how_to_apply: The notice says "online applications" are invited, but the application route it describes is by email. Applicants must email their CV along with the relevant document(s) to both addresses below, so that the application is received by 9 November 2026.
Prepare your CV and the relevant document(s).
Email them to [email protected] and [email protected].
Use an email address you can access, because all correspondence from INMS, University of Delhi, if any, is sent only to the email address provided by the applicant.
For a persistent technical issue, mail the problem to [email protected].
The notice does not give a subject line for the email.
Self-certified copies/testimonials (the notice mentions uploading these)
important_instructions: Applications that do not meet the eligibility criteria, or are incomplete in any respect, will be summarily rejected. Meeting the qualification or eligibility criteria does not entitle an applicant to selection. Applicants must not furnish false, tampered or fabricated particulars or suppress material information. INMS will verify antecedents at the time of appointment or at any time during the tenure. False or suppressed information leads to termination of service, without prejudice to other action. Canvassing in any form will be treated as a disqualification. Any addendum or corrigendum will be posted only on the institute website. The decision of INMS, University of Delhi is final in any dispute or ambiguity in the selection process. Disputes fall under the jurisdiction of Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 01 post in total, with the vacancy shown for all categories together. No category-wise break-up is printed.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice requires applicants to hold the prescribed qualifications and experience as on the closing date of application. A Ph.D. degree in Chemistry/ Nanomedical Sciences/ Life Sciences, with a Master's degree (M.S./ M.Sc./ M.Pharm or equivalent) in a relevant subject with at least 1st Division or 55% marks (or equivalent OGPA). At least 01 relevant high-impact publication (in Q1 or Q2 journals) in the area of nanomedicine, in Scopus indexed journals or UGC-CARE listed journals, as a first author or corresponding author. The maximum age is 35 years. The notice gives no minimum age and prints no date for counting age.

content_sections.text: The tenure of the post is temporary, non-regular, and strictly co-terminus with the specific research project. The notice does not name the project or its funding agency.
